method: 키워드 텍스트만 입력. 레퍼런스 이미지·이전 생성 시안·작품 및 기체 이름을 생성 입력에 포함하지 않음.

variants.title: 긴 외피형
variants.keywords: 긴 사선 · 넓은 금속 면 · 연속된 외피
variants.description: 길게 이어지는 외피와 사선으로 세로 흐름을 강조합니다. 금속 면의 크기와 반사로 형태를 읽히게 합니다.
variants.direction: Build each side column around ONE very long uninterrupted tapered silver shell. Tall slender architectural rails, widest near the upper-middle then tapering with a single confident diagonal toward the lower base. Few seams, no bulky shoulder blocks. A narrow deep dark slit reveals the inner skeleton along each outer edge. Tiny gold joint inserts only at the lower junction. A low continuous bottom rail with four shallow wedge input plates belongs to the same sweeping silver surface. Sleek long solid surfaces are the dominant silhouette.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished original full-frame design for a four-lane vertical falling-note rhythm game, based exclusively on the textual design vocabulary below.
Composition: portrait 2:3 illustration, one complete frame centered and fully visible with 6% margins on a plain charcoal backdrop. Straight-on front view, bilateral structural balance. The top is OPEN with no horizontal top bridge. Two side columns enclose a tall rectangular play field; exactly FOUR equal-width empty dark lanes are separated by three very subtle thin straight lines. Keep the inner lane edges perfectly vertical and unobstructed. Two slim pale-blue vertical gauge insets sit within the inner sides of the columns, no numbers. A lower assembly with exactly FOUR input plates, each aligned to one lane, fills about the bottom fifth of the total frame height. Design pillars, base, and input plates as one coherent machine. Give the playfield clear priority; no scenery or falling notes.
Shared visual vocabulary: thick substantial metal armor; large broad faceted planes; chamfered angular edges; long diagonals; armor overlaps with real thickness; deep dark joints and exposed blue-black inner structure; strong large-versus-small component hierarchy. Cool silver and slate-blue metal, dark blue-black skeleton, contrasting metallic gold structural inserts. Use gold selectively as metal, not glowing yellow decoration everywhere. Inset light sources reflect narrowly on nearby metal.
Medium: clean polished 2D anime mechanical concept illustration, deliberate contour drawing, broad cel-shaded planes, selective painted sharp metallic highlights. Controlled detail concentrated at joints. Clear readable silhouette and material planes, no photographic product render.
Input propulsion constraint: each of the FOUR lower input units has exactly ONE fixed continuous front-facing exhaust aperture. Aperture faces out of the screen toward the viewer, viewed end-on. No downward or sideways jet. Show the first and fourth apertures unlit, the second pale cyan, the third warm gold; all four input mechanisms and aperture geometry are identical. Cyan and gold have identical single-plume shape, just a different hue. Active light is a short foreshortened forward plume/bright core and restrained halo toward the viewer. No twin cores, split jets, moving shutters or extra holes.
No characters, faces, heads, helmets, horns, humanoid limbs, wings, weapon barrels, logos, text, lettering, numbers, callouts, extra views, miniature designs, decorative HUD panels, repeated tiny louvers or gratuitous spikes. One new frame per image.

variants.title: 두꺼운 소켓형
variants.keywords: 두꺼운 장갑 · 깊은 홈 · 큰 덩어리
variants.description: 두툼한 외장과 깊이 들어간 연결부로 묵직한 기계 프레임을 구성합니다.
variants.direction: Use wide thick vertical monolithic rectangular armor casings with boldly beveled corners, nearly parallel outer edges, short stepped transitions and deep recessed dark sockets. Each pillar reads as one heavy elongated block, not a thin blade. The gold metal appears recessed behind silver rims, emphasizing depth. The bottom is a thick horizontal plinth containing four deep-set rectangular input plates. Strong squared-off mass, large dark inset panels and substantial silver border thickness define this industrial design; keep the lane opening generous.

variants.title: 노출 골격형
variants.keywords: 드러난 골격 · 부품 간 간격 · 장갑의 단차
variants.description: 장갑 사이로 내부 골격을 드러내고, 큰 판과 가는 연결부의 대비를 강조합니다.
variants.direction: Make the outer half of each pillar visibly open: one dark load-bearing vertical spine with three large widely spaced silver armor anchor plates and a few diagonal structural struts. Real negative-space gaps between armor pieces reveal the dark background. The continuous inner edge and gauge are straight and protected. Large silver plates are separated by long dark exposed skeleton sections, not a solid shell. Gold clamps emphasize the load-bearing joints. Four input units are mounted into one shared dark bottom chassis with a strong silver beam underneath. The unmistakable open scaffold silhouette is the key.

variants.title: 상부 확장형
variants.keywords: 큰 상부 외장 · 가는 연결부 · 아래로 좁아지는 윤곽
variants.description: 좌우 상단에 큰 외장 덩어리를 두고 아래로 갈수록 가늘게 이어집니다.
variants.direction: Concentrate mass in the TOP THIRD of both side columns. Each tall rail begins in one broad outward-expanded angular silver cap/housing, then narrows sharply into a long slim shaft beneath. Each top housing has a single broad gold inset face and deep dark underside. Upper corners spread outward but remain compact geometric armor, not wings or horns. Mid-height and lower side rails are deliberately narrow. Use a modest low bottom crossbeam with four compact input plates. Strong top-heavy silhouette: broad capped upper side volumes, thin waist and visually light lower assembly.

variants.title: 하부 집중형
variants.keywords: 하단의 중량감 · 넓은 받침 · 추진부 일체화
variants.description: 가느다란 상부 기둥이 넓은 하단 외장으로 모여 입력부를 받치는 형태입니다.
variants.direction: Concentrate mass in the BOTTOM THIRD: very narrow upper columns widen gradually through long outward diagonals into broad thick lower-side buttresses that merge seamlessly with the four-unit input base. Low wide stance, taper rising upward. Large silver lower armor planes overlap a broad dark inner engine foundation; gold plates appear at the diagonal junctions near the bottom. No broad upper caps. The four input plates are integrated flush into the shared substantial lower assembly. The defining silhouette is an anchored heavy base with long slender upper rails.

variants.title: 교차 장갑형
variants.keywords: 겹친 외장 · 사선 이음부 · 두 단계 깊이
variants.description: 두 장의 큰 외장이 중간에서 겹치며 안쪽 골격과 금속 면의 깊이 차이를 드러냅니다.
variants.direction: Each side pillar is formed from exactly TWO broad elongated armor shells with a dramatic diagonal overlap around mid-height. The upper shell sits forward and sweeps inward; the lower shell sits behind and sweeps outward, producing one clear offset/kink in the outer silhouette. A deep dark seam with a recessed gold structural strip marks their diagonal interlock. Avoid repeated stacked small plates. Continue this two-layer overlapping language into a compact bottom housing around the four input plates. Broad contrasting-depth planes and one strong diagonal mid-joint distinguish this frame.
